title: Engine-Agnostic Model Hot-Swapping for Cost-Effective LLM Inference
problem: LLM inference services face cost/efficiency challenges: GPUs must handle bursty requests, leading to underutilization and high costs; models must be swapped between GPU and host memory.
motivation: Large-scale inference is expensive; dynamic model loading/unloading via hot-swapping can reduce costs if engine-agnostic; recent GPU drivers enable transparent checkpointing.
method: SwapServeLLM: engine-agnostic hot-swapping using GPU checkpointing. Mechanisms: (1) demand-aware preemption via concurrent request info, (2) memory-aware routing with minimized latency.
key_novelty: Engine-agnostic hot-swapping for LLM inference using transparent GPU checkpointing; unified approach across vLLM, Ollama, etc.
primary_theme: Engine-agnostic LLM model hot-swapping for cost-effective inference
